Theme: 꼬마 용 마법학교 대모험 — 달빛 천문탑 관측 수업. Scene: A magical moonlit astronomy classroom at the top of the same whimsical dragon academy high above the clouds, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle. A huge open arched window reveals a deep indigo night sky, a large cream crescent moon, soft cloud banks, and tiny distant stars; cream stone walls, dark-teal roof beams, antique-brass rails, plum-purple blank pennants, and orderly wooden platforms create a cozy observatory. At center, the recurring friendly young red baby dragon stands fully visible on a round cream platform and wears one oversized cobalt-blue neckerchief tied in a broad simple knot. At upper left, exactly three large antique-gold five-point-star lanterns hang in one straight horizontal row from short separate cords, clearly isolated against a plain indigo sky area with open space between them. At upper right, one large antique-brass telescope points diagonally upward and is fully visible in profile; its wide cream side panel bears one oversized vivid-turquoise crescent-moon emblem. At lower left, the gentle owl teacher in a deep-teal robe holds one large coral-red triangular teaching pointer on a short natural-wood handle, clearly isolated against a plain cream wall. At lower right, one large closed plum-purple astronomy case stands front-facing on a low cream table; its cream front panel bears one oversized vivid-turquoise diamond emblem. Include one small mouse apprentice with round brass goggles, one small background baby dragon, a simple brass armillary sphere, blank rolled charts, plain lens cases, tiny golden sparkles, and small cloud puffs only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the blue neckerchief, three gold star lanterns, turquoise telescope crescent, coral triangular pointer, and turquoise case diamond large, crisp, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, numbers, runes, logos, constellations shaped like writing, or clock numerals..
Art direction: original premium whimsical European storybook game illustration matching the established dragon-academy hatchery, cloud-flight, and potion-lab stages, with a cozy magical-school atmosphere, clean expressive ink contours, soft cel shading, gently hand-painted paper texture, polished animated-feature background quality, friendly rounded fantasy creatures, crisp object silhouettes, cohesive indigo night, sky blue, deep teal, cream, antique gold, plum purple, sunflower yellow, coral red, vivid turquoise, and cobalt blue palette, not imitating any specific artist or franchise.
Do not include text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, borders, split screens, or watermarks.
Keep important objects away from the outer 3% safe margin.
